Hi,

I have multiple imzML files that I would like to merge prior to any processing, so that i end up with the same peaks for all samples. the data were all acquired with the same parameters and have the same number of m/z values stored in the raw data files. i tried the combine function as described in other threads, but get an error that seems very generic, so i am a bit clueless and would be grateful for any input:

this is my code:

rm(merged_samples)
for (rawdata_filename) in rawdata_filenames {
  data <- readMSIData(rawdata_filename)
  if (exists("merged_samples") == FALSE) {
        merged_samples <- data }
  else {
        merged_samples <- combine(merged_samples, data) 
  }
}

and this is the error i get:

Error: is of unsupported type S4

thanks!!
